units.source_text: 阿民对工作越来越拼命，她一个人承担着所有男人应该做的工作。

en.t: Amin threw herself more and more desperately into her work, taking on by herself all the work that the men should have done.

units.source_text: 时而，夜晚还提着灯在菜园里巡查。

en.t: At times, she would even carry a lamp at night and make rounds through the vegetable garden.

units.source_text: 阿住对这个巾帼不让须眉的儿媳妇，心里充满着敬佩之情。

en.t: Aju felt her heart filled with admiration for this daughter-in-law, a woman who yielded nothing to any man.

units.source_text: 不，与其说是敬佩，毋宁说是敬畏更为准确。

en.t: No, rather than admiration, it would be more accurate to call it awe.

units.source_text: 阿民把除了田地、山里的工作之外，其他工作都交由阿住负责。

en.t: Amin left all the other work to Aju, apart from the work in the fields and the mountains.

units.source_text: 最近一段时间，阿民连自己的贴身衣物也很少洗了。

en.t: Lately, Amin had even begun washing her own underclothes only rarely.

units.source_text: 就算是这样，阿住也没有丝毫怨言，硬挺着已经佝偻的腰背，拼命一直做。

en.t: Even so, Aju never uttered the slightest complaint, but forced her already bent back upright and kept working with all her might.

units.source_text: 不仅仅是这样，只要碰见邻居阿婆，也总会严肃认真的夸奖自己的儿媳妇：

en.t: Not only that, whenever she met the old woman next door, she would always praise her daughter-in-law with a grave and earnest expression:

units.source_text: “无论如何，像阿民这么的勤奋工作，即使我死了，也无须担心家里的事情了。”

en.t: “At any rate, with Amin working so hard, even if I die, there will be no need to worry about the household anymore.”
